values.Description:
Annaprashan Decoration Kit (69 Pieces) - Baby Ceremony Set

This 69 piece Annaprashan decoration kit is made for a baby's first food ceremony and brings together red and gold metallic balloons, a Shubh Annaprashan Banner, themed Annaprashan Cutouts and red heart foil balloons. It is suitable for families preparing a coordinated wall decoration for the Annaprashan ceremony, baby rice ceremony or baby first food ceremony.

The setup can be arranged in a room at home, a hotel room, a banquet hall or another party venue. The banner and cutouts can form the central wall backdrop while the metallic balloons and heart foil balloons can be arranged around it. The included LED Light can be placed around the display for a lit backdrop that can be used for family photos and ceremony pictures. The photos show the banner positioned across the upper wall area with the red and golden balloon arrangement around the display and the Annaprashan cutouts placed across the central backdrop.

The pack also includes basic installation aids, so the buyer does not need to add a separate balloon pump, arch tape or glue dots to use the listed setup pieces. The arrangement can be adapted to the available wall area while keeping the banner and printed cutouts visible in the centre.

WHAT YOU GET (69 Pieces)

1 Shubh Annaprashan Banner

20 Metallic Balloons Red

20 Metallic Balloons Golden

16 Annaprashan Cutouts

8 Red Heart Foil Balloons

1 Led Light

1 Balloon Pump

1 Arch Tape

1 Glue Dots

KEY FEATURES

69 Pieces - Brings the listed decoration pieces and setup accessories together in one kit

20 Red Metallic Balloons - Forms the red part of the balloon arrangement around the backdrop

20 Golden Metallic Balloons - Adds the gold-toned part of the balloon arrangement

16 Annaprashan Cutouts - Adds printed ceremony and food-themed pieces to the wall display

8 Red Heart Foil Balloons - Adds heart-shaped foil pieces around the decoration

PERFECT FOR

Annaprashan Ceremony

Baby Rice Ceremony

Baby First Food Ceremony

Room Decoration

Home Party Decoration

Hotel Room Decoration

Banquet Hall Decoration

Photo Booth Backdrop

WHY CHOOSE THIS KIT

The set combines the main wall decoration pieces with a balloon pump, arch tape and glue dots for putting the displayed arrangement together. The red and gold combination gives the backdrop a coordinated look while the printed cutouts provide Annaprashan and food-themed details for photographs.

The decoration can be arranged around the Shubh Annaprashan Banner and adjusted to the available wall space. The included setup accessories help with inflating and positioning the balloons and fixing the decorative pieces.

Inflate the metallic balloons with the included Balloon Pump and use the Arch Tape to arrange them into the desired balloon display.
